guide:
Memory (dsh-claude-mem): memories live across sessions. What is injected is an index only (each line <= 60 chars); call mem_read for the body.
· Record: user preferences and red lines, project decisions and their reasons, gotchas and corrections, and how a thing unfolded (topic).
· Do not record: paths/ports/versions that code or config already answers; secrets and credentials (rejected); one-off process chatter.
· When: the user says "last time / we agreed", or a design tradeoff for this project comes up — read the index first, then mem_read. If nothing hits, do not pad.
staleHint: point-in-time observation, not live; verify before asserting
